values.note: 2026 rate $48/night April-November plus tax, every site full hookup, up to 4 people (or immediate family), one RV and one tow vehicle; extra person (12+) or vehicle $5. 7 nights 10% off ($43.20), 14 nights 20% off ($38.40); 10% off for FMCA, WIT, FCRV members and club rallies, 20% for SMART members. A $25 deposit (credited at check-in) guarantees a site.

values.note: Reserve by phone (276-236-0300) or the website's request form, which is 'processed manually within 24 hours'; a $25 deposit guarantees a site but sites are not assigned. 'Reservations are not required ... We welcome guest without reservations you can choose an available site upon check-in. Please call before you arrive.' After hours, walk-ins pick a vacant site and pay in the envelope box. '14 Night Maximum Stay, No Long Term'; no seasonal sites.

summary: Operator's own 2026 pages: $48/night (all sites full hookup, 50/30/20 amp, water, sewer, wifi), 36 big-rig gravel sites, open April-November, reservations by phone/form with walk-ins welcome, 14-night maximum. Not stated by the operator: showers/laundry (only a quoted guest review mentions them), pull-throughs, max rig length.
flags: Price gate: $48/night base (2026, before tax) on the operator's rate page, just under US$50.
